items.title: The Tor groups of the injective hull against the residue field over a Gorenstein ring
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement computes the Tor groups of the injective hull of the residue field against the residue field over a Noetherian local Gorenstein ring: they vanish except in degree equal to the dimension, where they equal the residue field (author lemma at source lines 4221-4227, label lemma-tor-injective-hull). The proof (source lines 4229-4243) identifies the hull with the local cohomology of the shifted structure sheaf and computes the derived tensor through the interaction statement, arriving at the shifted residue field (proof lines 4229-4242). The two identifications are the substance. H3.
